about_the_game:
Mana Land brings multiplayer thrills into a single-player RPG with thousands of AI-powered players online. They think, feel, and have unique personalities. Explore stories, trade, make friends or team up for dungeons, quests, and PvP. It's a world where AIs have souls, and stories are shared.

AI Beyond Chats

Unlike typical AI chatbots, AI players have their own avatars in Mana Land where they will join you on your quests, raid dungeons, trade with you and so much more!

Raid

Enjoy exciting team oriented gameplays, previously exclusive to multiplayer games. Form parties to raid dungeons or take down epic world bosses for epic loots.

Trading

Engage in organic, player-like trading with AI characters. Bargain, barter, and discover goods that's not available from NPC merchants.

PVP Battlegrounds

Test your skills against other AI players in fierce battles. Use tactics and coordination to outplay the opponents and rise through the ranks.

Socialize & Form Communities

You'll find hundreds of AI players in the Mana Land, all with unique backgrounds and characters. Interact and socialize with them just like real people. Add your newly made friend to your friends list. Form a party to raid dungeons, or create a guild to grow a long lasting community.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Apple M1 GPU or Intel Iris Plus Graphics 655
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro / M1 Max GPU, or AMD Radeon Pro 5500M
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
